note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Three contests, all in the Coalisland area: Mountjoy, Meenagh and Coalisland; 'All 13 retiring Unionist members and five Nationalists are returned unopposed' (Northern Whig, 21 May 1958, p. 9). John Harvey was nominated for Clonavaddy in place of Mr. Francis Cush, Nationalist member for 30 years, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
